title: decade drops the side mouse buttons unless config.toml turns them on
body:
ghostty never clears a side mouse button after one press and release. Jack checked this on 2026-11-12 in a ghostty run directly under Hyprland, so decade is not the cause. The terminal reports the press, SGR `<129;…M`, and never the release. From then on it reports every motion as a drag with button 9 held, SGR code 161. crossterm drops those reports, so coax in that pane gets no motion and draws no hover. A second click of the thumb button clears it.

decade sends every button to clients through `State::forward_button` in `decade/src/server/compositor/input.rs`.

## Proposal

- A `side_buttons` key in `config.toml`, on `Settings`, false by default. The settings panel gets no row for it.
- While it is false, `forward_button` drops `BTN_SIDE`, `BTN_EXTRA`, `BTN_FORWARD` and `BTN_BACK`, codes `0x113` to `0x116`.

## Rejected

- Dropping them only for ghostty windows, found by app id. That costs a lookup on every button event for one program's bug, and Jack uses the side buttons nowhere in decade.
- Reporting it to ghostty. Jack decided against it.
